name: camayoc_github_participating_threads
description: github-activity Q6: pull requests and issues where login <login> (lower-case) acted or was @-mentioned, with the latest activity time on each. Participation is judged here, at read time; it is never stored.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT ?thread ?kind (MAX(?at) AS ?last) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?a aegis:aboutGitHubEntity ?e ; aegis:occurredAt ?at . { ?a aegis:githubActorLogin ?who . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?who)) = "{login}") } UNION { ?a aegis:githubMentions "{login}" } } GRAPH ?g2 { { ?e aegis:onGitHubThread ?thread . } UNION { ?e a aegis:GitHubPullRequest . BIND(?e AS ?thread) } UNION { ?e a aegis:GitHubIssue . BIND(?e AS ?thread) } } GRAPH ?g3 { ?thread a ?kind . } } GROUP BY ?thread ?kind ORDER BY DESC(?last)
